semantics: Declares the baseline_exceptions registry consumed by ModuleBoundaryBaselineRulesTest: two keys (notifications_domain_imports, notifications_mail_imports), both empty arrays — i.e. the declared baseline is 'no cross-module import of Notifications\Domain or \Mail exists anywhere'.
mechanism: PHP array literal; consumed as $expected in assertImportsMatchBaseline (ModuleBoundaryBaselineRulesTest.php:27-67)

semantics: Declares code_roots (host_app=app, backend_shared=shared, core_backend=core-backend) and app_specific_roots. Metadata only: no test in tests/Architecture reads either key.
mechanism: PHP array literal; no consumer
retrofit_note: Mapped to the spec's roots: block, not to a rule. Dead config in the legacy setup (no reader).

semantics: Declares the module registry: 14 backend module names. Consumed by HttpBoundaryRulesTest (iterates it to scope its scan) and by ModelOwnershipRulesTest::test_model_owner_modules_exist (referential integrity of model_owners).
mechanism: PHP array literal; foreach in HttpBoundaryRulesTest.php:9, in_array in ModelOwnershipRulesTest.php:39
retrofit_note: Registry itself is spec data, not a rule. registry_policy: exact additionally enforces that discovered == declared (S6), which legacy never checked.

semantics: Declares model_owners: 12 App\Models\* FQCNs -> owning module. Data for both ownership completeness and consumer checks.
mechanism: PHP array literal keyed by ::class constants

semantics: Declares allowed_model_consumers: for 12 models, the list of modules permitted to import them. User has the widest list (all 14 modules); AuditLog the narrowest (Audit, AdminUsers).
mechanism: PHP array literal keyed by ::class constants
exceptions: the allow lists themselves are the exception mechanism

semantics: Declares forbidden_model_import_rules: 6 (path, model, message) triples banning a direct `use App\Models\X;` inside one specific module sub-path, each naming the sanctioned module API in its message.
mechanism: PHP array literal; enforced by str_contains('use '.$model.';') in ModelOwnershipRulesTest.php:105
retrofit_note: 6 legacy entries merged into 4 limen rules by grouping the entries that share a banned model and remedy (2x PermissionProfile, 2x FolderItem).

semantics: Declares module_application_rules: 9 (path, import_prefix, allowed_imports, message) tuples. Within a path, any import matching the prefix must be on the allowlist.
mechanism: PHP array literal; regex built per entry in ModuleContractRulesTest.php:10-17 as /use\s+(<prefix>\\[^;]+);/m
retrofit_note: 9 legacy entries merged into 4 limen rules by grouping identical (import_prefix, allowlist) pairs across paths. All allowed_imports are dead FQCNs -> allow: [] (deviations D-06); the Messages entry can never match its own regex (D-07).

semantics: Declares support_module_import_rules: app/Support may import only allowlisted App\Modules\* classes; the allowlist is empty, so it is a total ban.
mechanism: PHP array literal with an explicit regex /use\s+(App\\Modules\\[^;]+);/m; enforced by LayerBoundaryRulesTest.php:71-81
retrofit_note: Merged with L-BE-CFG-09 into one rule: identical target_prefix and (after dead-entry removal) identical allowlist.

semantics: Declares model_module_import_rules: app/Models may import only allowlisted App\Modules\* classes; one allowlisted class (Auth\Domain\UserAuthNotificationDispatcher).
mechanism: PHP array literal with regex /use\s+(App\\Modules\\[^;]+);/m; enforced by LayerBoundaryRulesTest.php:83-93
retrofit_note: The single allowlisted FQCN is dead (no file declares it) -> allow: [] (deviations D-06).

semantics: Declares allowed_host_app_imports: 8 host App\ FQCNs backend-shared may import. App\Models\* is allowed structurally (documented at :7-9) and needs no entry; every other App\ class must be listed.
mechanism: PHP array literal; consumed by SharedBoundaryRulesTest.php:42
exceptions: 8 FQCNs; plus the structural App\Models\* carve-out
retrofit_note: limen cannot express 'structural carve-out + allowlist for the rest' (deviations D-01). Encoded as a ban on App\Modules\** with the one App\Modules\ allowlist entry as an exemption; behaviourally equivalent on this workspace.

semantics: Declares (in the doc comment) the structurally-public sub-namespaces of a shared module — Contracts\, Events\, Domain\, Presentation\ — and cross_module_concrete_application_allowlist, intentionally empty.
mechanism: PHP array literal + doc comment; the sub-namespace set is hard-coded in the regex at SharedBoundaryRulesTest.php:110
retrofit_note: Drove the retrofit's public_surface.php definition, tightening Tier-1's Application/** to Application/Contracts, Application/Events, Domain, Presentation.

semantics: Shared harness: config accessor, allowlist assertion helper, recursive .php file discovery with sorted() determinism, module-name-from-path, relative-path, FQCN-from-file (namespace + first class/interface/trait), regex import collector. Contains no rule of its own.
mechanism: PHP; RecursiveDirectoryIterator + preg_match
retrofit_note: Maps to the limen extractor + facts layer, not to a rule. 124 of the 776 test LOC are this harness.

semantics: Seven business modules (Auth, Folders, FolderItems, Projects, PermissionProfiles, Relationships, RelationshipRequests) must not contain the literal strings 'use App\Modules\AdminUsers\' or 'use App\Modules\AdminPolicies\'.
mechanism: str_contains over raw file text (not a regex); data provider supplies the 7 module paths
retrofit_note: Legacy uses substring match on raw text, so a commented-out import would false-positive; limen matches extracted dependencies (comments stripped) — strictly more accurate.

semantics: A module file may import another module's Application\ classes only via Contracts\ or an entry from the union of all module_application_rules allowlists. Same-module imports are skipped.
mechanism: namespace regex to find the owner module + preg_match_all /use\s+App\\Modules\\([^\\]+)\\Application\\([^;]+);/m
retrofit_note: Legacy matched only App\Modules\ imports, so concrete LitRev\BackendShared Application services were invisible to it; limen sees them (deviations D-08, 3 findings).

semantics: The repository must expose exactly one root docker-compose file (docker-compose.yml or .yaml).
mechanism: is_file() on two candidate paths, assertCount(1)
retrofit_note: Encoded as required_files: docker-compose.yml. limen asserts presence, not 'exactly one of two alternatives' — a repo shipping both would pass limen, fail legacy.

semantics: No module directory under app/Modules/* may contain a local 'docker' or 'deploy' directory.
mechanism: glob(base_path('app/Modules/*'), GLOB_ONLYDIR) + is_dir on the two candidate names

semantics: config('database.connections') must not define any key outside {sqlite, mysql, mariadb, pgsql, sqlsrv}, i.e. no module-scoped connection.
mechanism: array_keys over the Laravel runtime config array
retrofit_note: arch-facts/1 models source files and dependencies, not runtime config-array keys (deviations D-03).

semantics: For each declared module, no file inside it may import App\Modules\<other>\Http\*.
mechanism: preg_match_all /use\s+App\\Modules\\([^\\]+)\\Http\\/m, compared against the owning module name
retrofit_note: Http is not on public_surface.php, so the K4 rule already rejects every cross-module Http import; no separate rule needed.

semantics: A file whose path contains /Application/ may not import App\Modules\<any>\Infrastructure\* — including its own module's Infrastructure.
mechanism: path substring '/Application/' + preg_match_all /use\s+App\\Modules\\([^\\]+)\\Infrastructure\\([^;]+);/m
retrofit_note: Legacy bans same-module Application->Infrastructure too; limen's layer-dependency is also unit-agnostic, so semantics match.

semantics: No file in app/Models may import any App\Modules\*\Application\* class.
mechanism: preg_match_all /use\s+(App\\Modules\\[^;]+\\Application\\[^;]+);/m
retrofit_note: A strict subset of L-BE-CFG-09 (which bans ALL App\Modules\* from app/Models). The broader rule subsumes it.

semantics: Driver: applies assertModuleImportsWithinAllowlist to every support_module_import_rules entry.
mechanism: foreach over config + shared helper
retrofit_note: Driver for L-BE-CFG-08; the rule content lives in the config.

semantics: Driver: applies assertModuleImportsWithinAllowlist to every model_module_import_rules entry.
mechanism: foreach over config + shared helper
retrofit_note: Driver for L-BE-CFG-09.

semantics: Registry completeness: every .php file in app/Models must declare a class whose FQCN is a key of model_owners. A file from which no FQCN can be parsed also fails (by relative path).
mechanism: classNameFromFile (namespace regex + first class/interface/trait regex) + in_array against array_keys(model_owners)
retrofit_note: Structural/completeness rule, not a dependency rule. limen expresses it via artifact_sets.models + require_every_artifact_owned: true.

semantics: Referential integrity of the config: every value in model_owners must be a member of the modules registry. Reads no source file.
mechanism: in_array over two config arrays
retrofit_note: Not a rule but a spec-integrity condition; limen's S3 unknown-unit covers it and more (deviations D-02).

semantics: For each file under app/Modules, every imported App\Models\X that appears in allowed_model_consumers must have the importing module listed as a permitted consumer. Models absent from the map are ignored.
mechanism: moduleNameFromFile + preg_match_all /use\s+(App\\Models\\[^;]+);/m + in_array on the per-model list
retrofit_note: Legacy skips a model that has an owner but no allowed_model_consumers entry; limen's K3 would flag any non-owner importer of such a model. On this workspace all 12 owned models have consumer lists, so behaviour is identical.

semantics: Driver: for each forbidden_model_import_rules entry, no file under its path may contain the literal 'use <model>;'.
mechanism: str_contains on raw text
retrofit_note: Driver for L-BE-CFG-06.

semantics: The set of cross-module imports of App\Modules\Notifications\Domain\* (all modules except Notifications itself) must EQUAL the declared baseline exactly — a new import fails, and so does a declared entry that no longer exists.
mechanism: assertImportsMatchBaseline: collect per-file imports, sort, ksort both sides, assertSame

semantics: Same two-directional baseline equality for App\Modules\Notifications\Mail\*.
mechanism: assertImportsMatchBaseline

semantics: Driver: for each module_application_rules entry, builds /use\s+(<preg_quote(import_prefix)>\\[^;]+);/m and asserts every captured import is on that entry's allowlist.
mechanism: preg_quote + assertModuleImportsWithinAllowlist
retrofit_note: Driver for L-BE-CFG-07.

semantics: No file under backend-shared/src may sit inside an Http/ or Infrastructure/ directory at any depth.
mechanism: preg_match '#/(Http|Infrastructure)/#' on the src-relative path

semantics: Every `use App\...;` in backend-shared must be App\Models\* (structurally allowed) or on allowed_host_app_imports. Aliased imports are normalised by stripping ' as X' before comparison.
mechanism: preg_match_all /use\s+(App\\[^;]+);/m + preg_replace of the alias suffix
retrofit_note: See L-SH-CFG-01 and deviations D-01.

semantics: Inside backend-shared, an import of another shared module must have a tail matching ^(Application\(Contracts|Events)|Domain|Presentation)\ , or be on cross_module_concrete_application_allowlist. Same-module imports are skipped.
mechanism: namespace regex for owner + preg_match_all /use\s+LitRev\\BackendShared\\([^\\]+)\\([^;]+);/m + structural regex

semantics: In page files only, ban the raw success-shape fallback `response?.data ??` / `result?.data ??`.
mechanism: regex /\b(?:response|result)\?\.data\s*\?\?/g over file text; scoped by pageFilePattern (:54)
retrofit_note: The single allowedIn path exists in no module of the frozen workspace -> exempt_files: [] (deviations D-06).

semantics: In page files only, ban the local `message || t(...)` error fallback.
mechanism: regex /\bmessage\s*\|\|\s*t\(/g; scoped by pageFilePattern
retrofit_note: Both allowedIn paths are absent from the workspace -> exempt_files: [] (deviations D-06).

semantics: Ban console.log( in every analysed source file (matchIn: all-source-files), i.e. all .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx under src/ except .test./.spec./README.md.
mechanism: regex /\bconsole\.log\s*\(/g; file filter at :43-47,101-108

semantics: A file under src/shared/ must not import from @/modules/, @/app/ or @/auth/.
mechanism: sharedFilePattern (:57) + regex /^@\/(?:modules|app|auth)\//
retrofit_note: One legacy rule split into three limen rules because layer-dependency takes a single (from_layer, to_layer) pair.

semantics: A module file must not import @/modules/<other>/<deep/path> — a cross-module import whose tail contains a '/'.
mechanism: moduleFilePattern owner + regex /^@\/modules\/([^/]+)\/(.+)$/ with importedTail.includes('/')

semantics: A module file must not import an internal file of another module: the resolved target must be the module root, its index.*, or a root-level non-index file (isPublicModuleEntry, :150-163).
mechanism: normalizeImportTarget (alias @/ -> src/, relative resolution) + moduleRootPattern + isPublicModuleEntry
retrofit_note: Drove public_surface.js = {unit}/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}. Legacy is marginally stricter (excludes a root-level file literally named index.* from the sub-entry branch); on this tree the sets coincide.

semantics: WARNING when src/app/** imports a deep module path @/modules/<m>/{lib,hooks,components,pages}/...
mechanism: prefix test on relativePath + regex on the import specifier
retrofit_note: Requires severity to vary by importing layer under one public-surface definition (deviations D-09). 0 occurrences on this workspace.

semantics: WARNING when a page file exceeds 600 lines.
mechanism: content.split('\n').length vs pageWarningLineLimit

semantics: WARNING when a module entrypoint (src/modules/*/index.*) exceeds 80 lines.
mechanism: line count vs moduleEntrypointWarningLineLimit

semantics: WARNING when a hook file (src/hooks/** or src/modules/*/hooks/**) exceeds 350 lines.
mechanism: line count vs hard-coded 350

semantics: Every directory under src/modules must contain a root entrypoint index.js|jsx|ts|tsx.
mechanism: readdir of the module dir + membership test against moduleEntrypointNames (:8-13)
retrofit_note: limen's for_each_unit takes a single filename, not the 4-way alternation (deviations D-04).

semantics: WARNING when a module directory has no README.md.
mechanism: readdir membership test
retrofit_note: Merged with L-FE-13 — one limen rule emits both the missing-file and missing-section findings (deviations D-09).

semantics: WARNING when a module README.md is missing any of three required sections: /(^|\n)Odpowiedzialność:/, /(^|\n)Publiczne entrypointy:/, /Nie importować z zewnątrz/.
mechanism: three regexes tested against the README text; missing ids reported in the snippet

semantics: WARNING when a module exposes a root-level source file that is neither index.* nor one of the allowed public sub-entrypoint names (errors, api, routes, forms, selectors, tree — each in 4 extensions).
mechanism: readdir + extension filter + two set-membership filters
retrofit_note: 'closed set of filenames within a directory' is not expressible in K9 structure (deviations D-05). 0 occurrences on this workspace.

semantics: WARNING when a shared helper (src/shared/lib/** or src/shared/utils.*, excluding http/, i18n/, ui/, a11y.) is imported from outside src/shared but by fewer than 2 distinct modules — a fan-in cardinality rule.
mechanism: reverse import graph built in main() (:404-417) + per-target distinct-owner count
retrofit_note: K10 supports only metric: lines; no rule kind computes per-target fan-in (deviations D-10). 0 occurrences on this workspace.
